|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | yes (`layout.ts`) | yes | 27 |
| `app` | yes (`app.ts`, the app-document type) | yes | 3, none an SDUI node — ruled on objectui#9263 |
| `utility` | **none** | **none** | 0 |

Firing control: the same query resolves the `page` and `app` literals in the same directory; absent-token control 0. `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0's `ComponentPropsMap` (45 rows, all namespaced) declares none of the five — this is objectui's own surface, so the protocol is not consulted first.

## What is asked

For each of `utility`, `home`, `record`: either **declare** it (a node schema on both faces, the protocol's authority order per objectui#4631 applying if a spec row ever appears) or **unregister** it (协议没有的能力删; the objectui#4631 `check:component-surface-parity` gate then guards the class). The one `"type": "home"` document is read before either: if it is an app-document page kind rather than an SDUI node, it is objectui#9263's channel, not this one.
